context:
Public Continuum at main 6f2a114. User authorizes autonomous engineering, actual Claude consultation, and public retention of visible input/reply/metadata. Two actual pilot handoffs used a Python checkpoint adapter around a Rust CLI; source/WorkState/context copied into a fresh disposable SQLite store. Existing authored attempts were empty because the adapter cannot import referenced source snapshots and request/receipt Blobs. Selected next unit is minimal explicit object-closure import, no native format changes/model runner.
Native `get DB ID` returns {id,format_version:1,object:{type:'blob',bytes:[u8...]}} or {type:'snapshot',entries:[{path,blob:ID}]}. Snapshot v1 references only Blobs. Native `put DB FILE` validates type, native content identity, paths, size and dependency presence; it returns id. WorkState each attempt references source_snapshot (Snapshot), request (Blob), optional receipt (Blob), summary and declared dispatch state. Native context checks exact custody/kinds, not truth or request/receipt semantic binding. Handoff acknowledgements are explicitly forbidden as attempt receipts.
Proposed adapter option --import-objects FILE accepting {schema:'continuum.object_bundle.v1',objects:[the exact get envelopes]}. Read at most16MiB and256 objects for small auxiliary histories (documented adapter limits, not native capacities). Strict duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON rejection. Root/envelope keys explicit; format_version must exactly integer1; unique expected IDs. Permit only Blob/Snapshot; import all Blobs before Snapshots after current source capture but before WorkState storage/acceptance. No hash reimplementation: put each object via native CLI and require returned id equals expected before proceeding. Preserve exact bundle bytes and per-object native put files/outputs; no success manifest after any failure. Source IDs and historical attempt references never rewritten. Missing closure fails rather than dropping history. No retained-store migration or merge.
Plan exercise actual CSV baseline snapshot + exact implementation-call request and tool response from completed pilot as one explicitly authored receipt_recorded attempt. Preserve its original source snapshot, failed attempts/negative tests separate, and validate new context. Bundle ordering shouldn't matter because snapshots refer only Blobs. Record bounds, imported IDs/digest and native command log in checkpoint manifest.
request: Review this minimal import contract for an integrity or semantic trap that would change implementation. Recommend at most two necessary changes and the strongest failure/reconstruction tests. Avoid general platform design. Under 280 words. No execution/repository access is claimed.
